entities.name: Gilles Côté
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gilles Côté is a Canadian clergyman and prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the bishop for the Diocese of Daru-Kiunga. He was appointed bishop in 1999. He retired in 2021.
